candidates.source_description: A video depicting the Republic of China (Taiwan) as it existed in 1912, with a territory encompassing the entirety of present-day China and Mongolia.

Visit to Picasso is a 21-minute Belgian documentary directed by Paul Haesaerts, a Belgian artist, art historian and filmmaker. It was shot in Pablo Picasso’s studio in Vallauris, France, in 1949. In one scene, Haesaerts invited Picasso to paint on large glass plates while the camera filmed from the other side, giving viewers a canvas-eye view of each brushstroke. 

Picasso paints a bird, animals, a woman and a vase of flowers in thick lines. The film was nominated for a BAFTA for best documentar
